segments.text: Water quality monitoring should do more than display numbers.
It should help operators detect problems
and respond before they escalate.
Introducing DWMS.
Sensor data, real-time visualization,
and a traceable response workflow in one platform.
The hardware path supports pH, total dissolved solids,
and turbidity.
These demonstration readings are simulated.
Abnormal readings create alerts,
showing the affected parameter and condition.
DWMS connects detection with action,
requesting a response through predefined operating rules.
This pump activity is a simulation.
No physical equipment is controlled.
Critical conditions latch emergency mode,
request a stop, and prevent automatic restart.
Returning readings alone cannot clear the interlock.
Recovery requires an operator.
Once readings recover,
the operator confirms recovery,
allowing a controlled return to normal operation
and recording the transition.
Historical trends, device records, and site grouping
provide operational visibility across monitoring locations.
The software integration is tested with isolated fixtures.
Ethm is designed to explain authorized monitoring evidence.
Live AI remains unavailable until provider credit is restored.
AI never controls equipment.
DWMS, turning water data into accountable decisions.
Monitor, detect, respond.
Ahmed Alzahrani, Founder and Project Lead.
